desc: Black Whelp Hat: the dragonkin costume hat repainted in charcoal and obsidian BLACK sequins, with a glowing ember-orange belly panel and ember-orange tips on the spikes and horns, like Onyxia's brood: a cute homemade dragon whelp head hat covered in SHINY SEQUINS that shimmer: a snout with two nostrils, little horns and a frill of spikes down the back. Worn on its own as a hat: it sits on the head, above the brow, and the face is fully visible

Closed down the front; just the body suit, no hood
